title: Cowlitz Valley Wildlife League

services.name: Cowlitz Valley Wildlife League
services.desc: Mission:Enriching our recreational way of life while protecting the limited natural resources of Silver Lake. Vision:To be an organization that protects the past, present, and future of CVWL members. Goals:To protect and preserve the recreational and natural uses of Silver Lake, while recognizing our linkage to the land, water, and wildlife. Values:To recognize the varied needs and protect the interests of all members who seek recreation and solace
